gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I kept you waiting,' she said.
gaps.explanation: apologise for doing something: apologised for keeping me waiting.

gaps.lead: Everyone thought the concert was excellent.
gaps.explanation: 'Everyone thought it excellent' → 'made an excellent impression on everyone'.

gaps.lead: The exam regulations forbid the use of mobile phones.
They won't let you in without a ticket.
gaps.explanation: let somebody do → be allowed to do: won't be allowed in.

gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: He can't be in Spain — I saw him here this morning.
gaps.sentence: He ___ in Spain — I saw him this morning.
gaps.explanation: can't/cannot possibly be = it is impossible that he is.
